LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_QuestDescription: White ash, sourceless heat, and brief flashes in the sky keep appearing across the colony. A rebirth mark wrapped in pale flame is approaching this world. If you allow it to fall, you must protect it for twelve hours. An unknown machine intelligence will send three mechanoid waves at roughly 0.7, 1.0, and 1.3 times current threat points; the last wave also contains an elite. This quest has no acceptance deadline.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_QuestDialogue_Neiyu: Neiyu catches a flake of white ash. It leaves no warmth on her fingers. She says this is not the residue of death, but someone searching for a place to land from within a fire.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_QuestDialogue_Qinghe: Qinghe senses the heat currents answering one another like an unopened flower. She believes the flame holds a complete life, not a lure.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_QuestDialogue_Zhaoli: Zhaoli listens to the echo in the flame and says only, “She has died too many times. This time, something does not want her to return.”
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_OmenAshText: There is no fire and no smell of anything burned, yet white ash begins drifting across the colony. Each flake vanishes before touching the ground, leaving only faint heat behind.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_OmenHeatText: Heat sources briefly appear outdoors and on rooftops, contradicting every measurement. Pale flashes occasionally light the sky as a falling trajectory becomes clear.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_DefenseStartedText: White light tears open the sky as a landing coordinate appears. A mass of pale flame is crossing the atmosphere; the life sealed inside cannot help you yet. Once it lands, protect the rebirth flame for twelve hours.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_MarkerLandedMessage: The rebirth flame has landed and stabilized. The twelve-hour defense begins now.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_IncomingProgress: The rebirth flame is descending. A white-flame ground sigil marks its impact point.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_WaveWarningText: The rebirth flame has detected a group of unfolding machine transit coordinates. Wave {0} will arrive in about {1} seconds; cold beams around the core reveal the hostile targeting paths.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_WaveText: Mechanoid wave {0} has entered from the map edge. Its strength is roughly {1} times current threat points, and it will prioritize destroying the rebirth flame.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_WaveFinalText: The final mechanoid wave has entered from the map edge. Its base strength is roughly {1} times current threat points and it includes an elite centipede. It will prioritize destroying the rebirth flame.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_DefenseProgress: Defense: {0}/3 waves deployed; protect the flame for at least {1} more hours and eliminate every attacker.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AwaitingDecisionProgress: Reconstruction is complete. Mingyuan remains neutral while she waits for your answer. Select one of your colonists and right-click Mingyuan to speak with her.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_MarkerInspect: White flame defense: {0}/3 waves; {1} hours remain. The quest fails if the rebirth flame is destroyed.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ReformationText: The last hostile signal is gone. The rebirth flame releases its restraint; nested rings of fire unfold the seal and reconstruct the life within. The flame can no longer be damaged while reconstruction completes.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ReformationProgress: Embers Return: Mingyuan's reconstruction will complete in about {0} seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ArrivalText:
After the last mechanoid falls, the pale flame opens outward. A figure finishes rebuilding herself within the embers, but does not demand to join.
“I am tired of those worlds. If this place allows someone to live quietly, I would like to stay.”
She remains neutral for now. You can answer here, or select one of your colonists later and right-click Mingyuan to speak with her.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ArrivalDialogue_Neiyu: Neiyu waves to her. Mingyuan watches her for a moment, and the tension finally leaves her shoulders.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ArrivalDialogue_Qinghe: Qinghe catches one unburned flake of white ash and says there is room here for a fire that no longer has to flee.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ArrivalDialogue_Zhaoli: Zhaoli does not ask how many times she has died. She simply steps aside and leaves a path open. Mingyuan seems to understand this as welcome.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TalkUnavailable: Mingyuan is no longer waiting for an answer.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_NoPlayerHomeMap: There is currently no player settlement where Mingyuan can arrive.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_JoinedText: Mingyuan has joined the colony. She carries her fixed equipment and retains her complete pale-flame abilities.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_DeferredText: Mingyuan accepts your answer and leaves along a trail of embers. New signs will appear in about {0} days; she is not permanently lost.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_FlameDestroyedText: The rebirth flame was destroyed. The life within withdrew from this world before reconstruction could finish; Mingyuan was not killed or deleted.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_MapLostText: The map holding the rebirth flame is no longer available, so this defense cannot continue. Mingyuan was not killed or deleted.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RetryTwentyDays: In twenty days, the white-flame signs will seek out your colony again.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_QuestConcludedText: Mingyuan already exists in the world. The quest has ended automatically and all temporary enemies and markers were cleaned up, preventing a duplicate.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_QuestAbandoned: The white-flame quest was abandoned. Temporary enemies, markers, and the pending character were cleaned up. The signs can return in twenty days.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_QuestRetryScheduled: The white-flame signs are now on retry cooldown.
